heading: “Indian” defined for certain purposes
lead: For the purposes of sections 1932 and 1933 of this title, the term “Indian” shall include persons defined in section 1603(c) 1 of this title.

notes.text: References in TextSection 1603(c) of this title, referred to in text, was redesignated section 1603(13) of this title by Pub. L. 111–148, title X, § 10221(a), Mar. 23, 2010, 124 Stat. 935.
